author: Karl Rock
description:
I stumbled across a traditional snake charmer performing on Karachi’s main beach in Pakistan.

Snake charming ("Sapera" in Hindi) has existed across South Asia for centuries, although today it’s becoming a dying art and is mostly performed for tourists and curious crowds. But after stopping to watch for the first time in my life… this performance definitely did not go how I expected.

The cobra spent most of the show trying to attack the snake charmer rather than “dance”, while more and more people gathered around to watch - eventually even handing the snake to people in the crowd.

Later, I sat down with the snake charmer himself to learn more about his life, how he catches these snakes, and the strange health problems he claims years of handling them have caused him.

title: Pakistani Snake Charmer Can't Charm a Snake
